acceptanceCriteria: A1: crates/cockpit-repository/tests/contract_preflight.rs adds one shared helper asserting every HumanDecisionRequest field and each option's id/label/effect are non-empty and that recommended_option names one of the offered options.

A2: the helper is called from both existing needs_human_confirmation tests (scaffold_preflight_is_not_ready_and_records_human_review_requirements and high_risk_scenario_coverage_stops_at_preflight_for_human_review), covering two independently-triggered real scenarios.
A3: cargo test --locked -p cockpit-repository --test contract_preflight passes (7/7).
A4: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --test contract_preflight -- -D warnings pass.
A5: no existing assertion is removed or weakened; no production source file is modified.
goal: A regression that silently empties any part of a structured human decision request is caught automatically by cargo test on two independent real scenarios (an empty scaffold and a high-risk scenario-coverage gate), instead of relying on manual review.
intent: Close the invariant-9 gap named in WI-681's coverage mapping (docs/reference/collaboration-invariant-coverage.md, pending merge): extend the two existing preflight tests in crates/cockpit-repository/tests/contract_preflight.rs that already reach needs_human_confirmation to assert every HumanDecisionRequest field (what_happened, why_it_matters, question, resume_condition, options, recommended_option, recommendation_reason, and each option's id/label/effect) is non-empty and internally consistent, rather than adding a new test file or new production code.
outOfScope: any change to production code in crates/cockpit-core/src
invariants 7 and 8 test gaps (separate follow-on Work Items)
